linkedin.title: We decided to stop optimizing our news feed for engagement.
linkedin.body:
Most news apps are built like slot machines. They want you to keep scrolling forever, so they show you whatever makes you angry or anxious. It works for ad revenue, but it fails the reader. When we built the feed for Headlinne, we made a different choice.

Instead of chasing clicks, we optimize for relevance. We treat your time as a limited resource rather than a metric to be harvested. Our system focuses on understanding what you actually care about, not what you might accidentally tap on because of a flashy headline.

This meant building an AI that prioritizes signal over noise. It is a harder engineering challenge because it requires nuance. It means sometimes showing you less content, not more. We believe that if we help you find what you need quickly, you will trust us to do it again tomorrow. That is the only engagement model that matters to us.
